```plato

    //==
    // # Derived functionality for ITransformable2D / ITransformable3D
    //
    // Bodies for the `ITransformable2D` / `ITransformable3D` interfaces declared in
    // `transforms.concepts.plato`: the ordered multi-transform convenience
    // overloads, and the lifting of every transform representation through Deform so
    // that a single Deform primitive yields a complete transform surface.

    //==
    // ITransformable2D / ITransformable3D — a value that can be carried through the
    // general transform of its dimension. The convenience overloads below are named
    // ThenTransform rather than reusing the interface's `Transform` name: overloading a
    // interface-declared member on arity alone is easy to misread, and ThenTransform
    // states the sequencing intent.

    // Apply two transforms in order: `first` then `second`. Equal to
    // Transform(first.Compose(second)) — the helper exists so the caller does not
    // have to name the composition.
    ThenTransform(self: ITransformable2D, first: Transform2D, second: Transform2D): Self
        => self.Transform(first).Transform(second);
```
